title: Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions Rate Card and Entry Requirements
content:
# Rate Card and Entry Requirements

Rate card for Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions: the fees each tier is written at, and the entry requirements a building must meet before the tier is quoted.

## Fees

| Tier | Annual subscription fee before per-meter and per-user fees (USD per year) | Annual fee per included meter (USD per meter per year) | One-time setup fee for the subscription and the baseline (USD) | Energy site survey fee, credited against the setup fee when the subscription starts (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | 1200 | 0 | 450 | 0 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | 3600 | 240 | 1250 | 550 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | 8400 | 210 | 2400 | 550 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | 16800 | 185 | 4500 | 950 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | 34000 | 165 | 9500 | 1450 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | 86000 | 140 | 24000 | 2400 |


## Entry requirements

| Tier | Active automation service plan at the site required | Energy site survey required before the tier is quoted | Calendar days allowed to commission metering and data |
|---|---|---|---|
| Utility Bill Tracking Subscription | no | no | 30 |
| Metering & Dashboard Subscription | no | yes | 45 |
| Energy Analytics Subscription | yes | yes | 60 |
| Fault Detection & Diagnostics Subscription | yes | yes | 60 |
| Measurement & Verification Program | yes | yes | 90 |
| Managed Energy Performance Program | yes | yes | 120 |


## Rate card notes

- The annual subscription fee is the fee before any per-meter or per-user fee is added. The per-meter fee is an annual amount per included meter; on the Utility Bill Tracking Subscription it is 0.
- The setup fee is charged once. Where a site survey was carried out, the survey fee is credited against the setup fee when the subscription starts.
- The onboarding allowance is the number of calendar days allowed to commission metering and data.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Metering & Dashboard Subscription is written at USD 3600 a year plus USD 240 a year for each included meter, carries a USD 1250 setup fee against which a USD 550 survey fee is credited, needs a completed survey but no automation service plan, and has 45 calendar days to commission its data.
